Archive and feedback mutations are asynchronously visible and do not themselves change finding Count or UpdatedAt.

filter_observations: Default Action NOOP and Rank1. New omitted-rank filter inserts first; create rank beyond current count clamps to end. Update rank beyond current count rejects.
Same name/client token replays despite changed description; same token with a different name creates a separate filter. Same name with new/implicit token conflicts.
Rank move and deletion compact/reorder siblings without changing sibling Version/UpdatedAt. Direct update increments Version, including empty UpdateFilter.
Description omitted is null on raw wire; explicit empty string is retained. Punctuation bad!@#$ and non-ASCII cafe-with-accent were rejected.
Criteria responses emit both legacy/current aliases (eq+equals, gte+greaterThanOrEqual).
